prompt:
Use case: tightly masked continuation repair of an existing 2D animation foreground.
Edit Image 1. Preserve its native 1920 x 1080 canvas and its exact registration. This is the sole full pose target and the source artwork, not an invitation to redraw the character or reframe the picture.
Image 2 is an exact binary edit-permission mask at the same 1920 x 1080 registration: WHITE is the only region that may be painted; BLACK is strictly protected. The permitted white zone is near the very bottom, x560–935 and y1005–1079. Image 3 is an enlarged crop of the same lower-edge area of Image 1, solely to see its existing skin contour, local shading and two cut edges. It is not a different camera or a new pose. Do not copy its enlarged framing into the output.
TASK: The original registered foreground has two small bare forearm continuations cut off roughly 10–35 pixels above the bottom of the final canvas. Naturally continue BOTH existing forearms through that last gap and out of the bottom canvas boundary. Follow each original forearm's direction, width, continuous outside contour, delicate dark-brown line and restrained warm-peach cel shading. Begin the continuation through the existing cut-edge neighborhood inside the white region, with enough overlap for a seamless contour and local color transition. These are the SAME two arms; do not add a third arm, a sleeve, a new wrist, an extra hand, a cap line or a detached patch. The lower ends must truly exit the bottom frame, not end in a rounded stump inside it.
HARD PRESERVATION: Keep BOTH original hands, every visible finger, both wrists, the one red metal flashlight, silver shell, black slider, and all their pixels above/away from the white mask completely unchanged. Keep the flashlight's exact scale, angle, position and two already-registered support contacts unchanged. Do not move, resize, relight, repaint or reinterpret any protected area. In particular, never enlarge the torch to hide the cut ends. Do not change the camera or composition. Do not reconstruct any old mother pose.
OUTPUT: Return one full-canvas RGBA transparent foreground in the same registration, with only this small masked forearm-continuation repair. Everywhere outside the subject remains genuinely transparent. Do not add the box, cloth, sheet, scene, shadow, glow, ground, labels, arrows, mask colors, grid or text. Any output change outside the permitted mask will be discarded in favor of the exact original registered pixels. This is a local edge connection repair, not a new whole-character drawing.
